post.quote: Doers aren't fearless. They're willing to start while afraid.
post.practice: Start the thing you've been avoiding and give it five honest minutes before you decide anything.
post.question: What would you start if fear weren't in charge?

caption:
Doers start before they feel ready.

“Doers aren't fearless. They're willing to start while afraid.”
